description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for firmware upgrade on a Raspberry Pi device. It performs tasks such as downloading firmware images via TFTP or HTTP, verifying checksums, managing filesystems and partitioning, mounting and copying images, and switching active storage banks for firmware updates.

methods.name: tftpDownload
methods.description: Function to download firmware image and checksum via TFTP, verify checksum, and clean up temporary files.

methods.name: httpDownload
methods.description: Function to download firmware image and checksum via HTTP, verify checksum, and clean up temporary files.
